title: Etale algebras over a filtered colimit of rings descend to a finite stage
statement: Let $I$ be a small filtered category and $i\mapsto A_i$ a functor from $I$ to commutative rings with colimit $A=\varinjlim_IA_i$ [def-weil-pbc-category-colimit] and coprojections $\iota_i:A_i\to A$. Let $A\to B$ be a ring map such that $\operatorname{Spec}B\to\operatorname{Spec}A$ is etale [def-weil-etale-morphism]. Then there are an index $i\in I$, a ring map $A_i\to B_i$ with $\operatorname{Spec}B_i\to\operatorname{Spec}A_i$ etale, and an isomorphism of $A$-algebras $B\cong A\otimes_{A_i}B_i$ (tensor product formed via $\iota_i$).

source.place: Lemma Tag 00U2 (lemma-etale), item (9), and its proof ('Follows from (8) [an etale ring map is the base change of an etale $R_0\to S_0$ with $R_0$ of finite type over $\mathbf Z$] since $R_0\to A$ will factor through $A_i$ for some $i$ by Lemma Tag 00QO (lemma-characterize-finite-presentation)'); cited in more-algebra.tex, proof of Lemma Tag 0A02 (lemma-henselization)

proof.text: *A model over a finitely generated subring (Stacks: 'Follows from (8)').* By [lem-weil-pbc-etale-algebra-finite-type-model] applied to $A\to B$ there are a subring $A_0\subseteq A$ generated by finitely many elements, with inclusion $j:A_0\to A$, a ring map $A_0\to B_0$ with $\operatorname{Spec}B_0\to\operatorname{Spec}A_0$ etale, and an isomorphism of $A$-algebras $\varphi:B\xrightarrow{\sim}A\otimes_{A_0}B_0$, where $A$ is an $A_0$-algebra via $j$.

source.place: Lemma Tag 00U2, item (8), and the proof of (9)

proof.text: *The model ring factors through a stage (Stacks: '$R_0\to A$ will factor through $A_i$ for some $i$ by Lemma 00QO').* $A_0$ is of finite type over $\mathbf Z$ (step 1). By [lem-weil-pbc-finite-type-ring-map-factors-filtered-colimit] (1), applied to the filtered colimit $A=\varinjlim_IA_i$ and the ring map $j:A_0\to A$, there are $i\in I$ and a ring map $g:A_0\to A_i$ with $\iota_i\circ g=j$. (In the cited lemma the factorization is obtained elementwise: the finitely many generators of $A_0$ are images of elements of a common $A_\mu$, and the finitely many defining relations of $A_0=\mathbf Z[x_1,\dots,x_n]/(f_1,\dots,f_m)$, which hold in $A$, hold already in some later $A_i$.)

source.place: Lemma Tag 00U2 (lemma-etale), proof of (9): 'Follows from (8) since $R_0\to A$ will factor through $A_i$ for some $i$ by Lemma 00QO'

proof.text: *The etale algebra over the stage.* Regard $A_i$ as an $A_0$-algebra via $g$ and put $B_i=A_i\otimes_{A_0}B_0$, an $A_i$-algebra via $a\mapsto a\otimes1$. By [lem-weil-pbc-etale-ring-base-change] (with $R=A_0$, $A=B_0$, $S=A_i$), $\operatorname{Spec}B_i\to\operatorname{Spec}A_i$ is etale.

source.place: Lemma Tag 00U2 (3) (a base change of an etale ring map is etale), implicit in the proof of (9)

proof.text: *The isomorphism $B\cong A\otimes_{A_i}B_i$ (Stacks: implicit).* Regard $A$ as an $A_i$-algebra via $\iota_i$. Its $A_0$-algebra structure through $A_i$ is $\iota_i\circ g=j$ (step 2), the one used in step 1. Hence [lem-weil-pbc-tensor-cancel-base-change] (with $R=A_0$, $S=A_i$, the $S$-algebra $A$ and the $R$-algebra $B_0$) gives an isomorphism of $A$-algebras $\psi:A\otimes_{A_i}B_i=A\otimes_{A_i}(A_i\otimes_{A_0}B_0)\xrightarrow{\sim}A\otimes_{A_0}B_0$, $a\otimes(s\otimes b)\mapsto\iota_i(s)a\otimes b$. Then $\psi^{-1}\circ\varphi:B\xrightarrow{\sim}A\otimes_{A_i}B_i$ is an isomorphism of $A$-algebras, and $i$, $A_i\to B_i$ (etale by step 3) satisfy the statement.

lean.statement: theorem exists_etale_algebra_of_filteredColimit {I : Type u} [SmallCategory I] [IsFiltered I] (F : I ⥤ CommRingCat.{u}) [HasColimit F] (B : Type u) [CommRing B] (f : (colimit F : CommRingCat.{u}) ⟶ CommRingCat.of B) (hf : Etale (Spec.map f)) : ∃ (i : I) (Bi : Type u) (_ : CommRing Bi) (g : F.obj i ⟶ CommRingCat.of Bi), Etale (Spec.map g) ∧ let A : Type u := (colimit F : CommRingCat.{u}) letI : CommRing A := inferInstance letI : Algebra (F.obj i) A := (colimit.ι F i).hom.toAlgebra letI : Algebra (F.obj i) Bi := g.hom.toAlgebra letI : Algebra A B := f.hom.toAlgebra Nonempty (B ≃ₐ[A] (A ⊗[F.obj i] Bi))
